# SCiL Wiki

> > A comprehensive resource hub for creative tools, game development, and immersive technology education at SCiL Lab.

SCiL Wiki serves as the central documentation platform for the SCiL Lab, providing guides and references for 3D modeling, game engines, VR development, digital media production, and specialized equipment. The wiki supports students and creators with hands-on tutorials, equipment operating guides, and technical resources across multiple creative disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Game Development
- VR/XR Development
- 3D Modeling & Texturing
- Unreal Engine
- Godot
- Character Rigging
- 3D Printing
- Immersive Technology
- Photography & Cameras
- 360 Video Production
- Substance Painter
- ZBrush
- Equipment Guides
- Creative Tools
- Asset Management

## Game Development & Engines

- [Godot](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/godot): Godot engine VR development guide with GDScript and XR programming
- [XR Rig Setup](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/unreal-engine/page/xr-rig-setup): Unreal Engine XR rig setup guide using OpenXR and Blueprint

## 3D Modeling & Character Creation

- [Character Creation](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/character-creation): Character creation and rigging guide using Actorcore Accurig and tools
- [Texturing](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/texturing): Texturing guide covering Substance Painter, Blender, Maya, and PBR materials

## VR & Immersive Technology

- [Headsets](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/headsets): VR headset documentation for Meta Quest and Oculus devices setup
- [Immersive 360 Video](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/immersive-360-video): 360 video production guide with GoPro, Canon, and Unreal integration

## Digital Fabrication & Manufacturing

- [3D Printing](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/3d-printing): 3D printing equipment guide for MakerBot, Phrozen, Bambu, and MarkForged
- [xTool Laser Cutter](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/xtool-laser-cutter): Operating guide for xTool P2S 55W laser cutter with safety and maintenance

## Photography & Digital Media

- [Photography Basics](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/photography/page/photography-basics): Photography fundamentals covering exposure triangle, ISO, aperture, and sensors
- [Canon EOS 5D MKIV](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/photography/page/canon-eos-5d-mkiv): Canon EOS 5D MKIV photography equipment guide with lens switching
- [Canon EOS 5D MKIV DSLR](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/photography/page/canon-eos-5d-mkiv-dslr): Canon EOS 5D MKIV DSLR operating guide and camera technology reference

## Wiki Organization & Navigation

- [SCiL Wiki](https://scil-wiki.su.edu): SCiL Lab wiki homepage for game development, 3D modeling, and creative tools
- [Books](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books): Main directory of creative tools and game development documentation books
- [Shelves](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/shelves): Content organization and asset management directory for SCiL Wiki resources
- [Tags](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/tags): Tag management and content categorization system for SCiL Wiki
- [SCiL](https://scil-wiki.su.edu/books/scil): SCiL Lab documentation including Git quickstart and server information
